notes.title: SUBNET - Escape Room Adventure Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]*If you are part way through a game please complete before you update![/b]

The latest update to Version 1.0.3 of SUBNET - Escape Room Adventure is here, bringing with it a host of bug fixes and tweaks that make the game better than ever before.

One of the biggest updates is the revamped Save System, which has been fine-tuned to provide a seamless gaming experience. Simply pick up where you left off without any hassle. 

[b]However, *please note that if you're in the middle of a game, it's best to finish before updating to avoid losing progress.[/b] I apologize for any inconvenience caused, but trust me, it was necessary for the improvements.

I hope you'll love the updates, and as always, I’m open to feedback and suggestions. If you have any thoughts, feel free to send me an email at games@m9games.co.uk. 

Thanks for reading, and enjoy the update!

notes.title: SUBNET Escape Room Adventure Version 1.0.2
notes.notes: I have released an update that includes bug fixes for some of the levels and an improved save system. Put your puzzle solving skills to the test and help track down the drkFORCE hacker group before they escape the underground subway system. With the help of your AI assistant, you must act quickly to prevent the hackers from carrying out their plans. Don't forget to update your game and get ready to stop the cyber attack!
